text: じてんしゃは　きみが　すきに　のったら　ええ！

structure.jp: きみが　すきに　のったら　ええ！
structure.en: you go ahead and ride it as you like!

patterns.name: 〜たらいい
patterns.explanation: A verb with たら plus いい means 'you should do it, go ahead and do it'. ええ is the old-man and western-dialect form of いい. のったら　ええ = 'go ahead and ride it'.

patterns.name: 〜に (adverb)
patterns.explanation: に after a word like すき turns it into a word that tells how something is done. すきに = 'as you like'.
